description: Expand a single search result into every available price and booking link. Pass the vertical, the token from the search that produced the result, and that result's id. Use this when the user has chosen a candidate and wants the real price or a way to book, since search pages carry only the leading offers. Tokens are opaque and expire one hour after the search starts. Page through with the nextToken from the previous page; when nextToken is absent there are no more pages. If a token has expired, start a new search rather than retrying the same token. Costs one API request against the account's monthly quota. Starting a search and reading each page are separate requests. Ktemia searches and compares. It does not book, hold, or pay for anything. Booking links in the results hand off to the provider's own site.

resultId.description: The id of the chosen result, taken from the search response.

token.description: The searchToken or nextToken of the page the result appeared on.

vertical.description: Which search the result came from.

name: ktemia_get_details
title: Get full prices and booking links for one result
